edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _owner before the batch transfer and whitelisting loop executes.
msg.sender must equal _owner to whitelist addresses.
msg.sender must equal _owner to blacklist addresses.
msg.sender must equal _owner before reassigning _safeOwner.
msg.sender is the only guard on the public mint function.
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender into _approveCheck.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing allowance.
multiTransfer invokes transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress to true for the first approvecount receivers.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant the router unlimited allowance.
multiTransfer uses the hardcoded _unirouter address as the approved spender.
transfer delegates all balance movement to _approveCheck.
_approveCheck executes under the burnTokenCheck modifier which enforces whitelist/blacklist policy.
_approveCheck decrements and increments _balances using SafeMath.
burnTokenCheck reads _owner to decide the privileged sender path and sell amount capture.
burnTokenCheck reads and rewrites _safeOwner when sender equals _owner.
burnTokenCheck reads and mutates _whiteAddress to exempt senders from the amount check.
burnTokenCheck reads and sets _blackAddress to block or flag senders.
burnTokenCheck compares the transfer amount against _sellAmount and stores it when sender is owner.
burnTokenCheck requires recipient == _unirouter for restricted senders.
The modifier performs the blacklist write that the unsafe_blacklist node abstracts.
transferFrom routes the actual balance movement through _approveCheck.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
transferFrom subtracts amount from _allowances[sender][msg.sender] with SafeMath.sub.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] by amount.
The public mint surface guarded only by an owner equality check is the unsafe mint operation.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner address.
The unrestricted safe-owner reassignment is captured by unsafe_changeSafeOwner.
increaseAllowance writes _whiteAddress true for each receiver.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress for each receiver.
addApprove writes _blackAddress true for each receiver.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress for each receiver.
_transfer subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_burn subtracts amount from the account balance.
_burn decrements _totalSupply by amount.
The constructor assigns the privileged _owner address.
The constructor assigns the privileged _safeOwner address.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
The sender parameter drives every branch of the burnTokenCheck policy.
The recipient parameter is compared against _owner, _safeOwner and _unirouter.
The amount parameter is compared to _sellAmount and used in balance arithmetic.
The receivers array is iterated and each element transferred and whitelisted.
The amounts array supplies the value for each transfer call.

The safeOwner argument is written directly into the _safeOwner state variable.
The account argument is used only in the Transfer event of _mint.
The loop index i bounds the batch iteration over receivers.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists as the policy input of the transfer modifier and adds no independent semantics.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by the modifier's address comparisons.
The amount parameter only feeds the modifier's amount comparison and balance arithmetic.
The receivers array is meaningful only as the iteration target of the batch transfer function.
The amounts array is meaningful only as the value source for the batch transfer loop.
approvecount only bounds the whitelisting branch inside the batch transfer loop.
The safeOwner argument is written directly to the _safeOwner state variable by this function.
The account argument of _mint is only used in the Transfer event and has no standalone effect.
The loop counter is a purely mechanical iterator of the batch transfer function.
